map_definitions.sam: Four-neighbor SAM label discontinuities on both adjacent pixels; precise Euclidean distance d; exp(-d*d/(2*sigma*sigma)); zero for an edge-free label map; no dilation/hard threshold.
map_definitions.depth: Unchanged normalized_sobel: 3x3 Sobel/8 magnitude, eroded valid finite(depth)&alpha>.5; divide by valid q95, clamp [0,1].
map_definitions.rgb: Unchanged normalized_sobel on cv2 RGB-to-gray, q95 normalization, clamp [0,1].

projection: Sum all training-view/pixel alpha*T * continuous map / sum alpha*T, using original native anisotropic source footprints, opacity>=1/255 and T>=1e-4; not dominant-only and not Gaussian-center sampling.
visibility_semantics: Bitwise copy of unchanged shared.visibility for source identity. Continuous strengths use newly accumulated alpha*T denominator; its agreement with shared denominator is audited separately.
